title: The cursor row is a rounded accent plate with three actions
steps: Launch Mail with -UseFakeData; press j a few times in the Inbox
Move the pointer over another row, then over the cursor row's three buttons
Click the check mark, then press Cmd-Z
Turn on Increase Contrast in System Settings › Accessibility › Display and look again
expected: Cursor row: a rounded accent tint, no bar; a hovered row: a faint grey plate. In place of the date, three accent glyphs: check (Mark done), clock (Snooze), bell (Remind me); each gets a soft fill under the pointer and shows its name. Label and Trash stay in the right-click menu and on L and #. The check marks it done; Cmd-Z brings it back. With Increase Contrast the plate has an edge.
